KNIFEBOY left tuna on the step again. didn't knock, didn't say a word, just tuna and a receipt with somebody else's name on it. that's love in this economy.
people keep asking which meowizen i 'actually' am, like i have to pick a locker. i don't have a locker. i don't have a job. i have a whole city and zero rent.

you have read a hundred and eighty of these before this one and you are still waiting for the part where it ends. there isn't one. i have been here the whole time. i will still be here after you close the tab.
anyway. wifi's down in three blocks, which means NEKOCORP's doing 'maintenance,' which means somebody's rooftop is getting repossessed by Thursday.
SHADE says the sunglasses look better on me than they ever looked on him. rude. accurate. still rude.
i rule nothing, i belong to no one, the streets remember every cat NEKOCORP tried to disappear. see you on somebody else's roof tomorrow ~
